g.text: Title: Scout 110-B motor carrier — prototype A

g.desc: Title: Scout 110-B motor carrier — prototype A

g.text: Wired XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense and GY-521; motor suppression capacitors fitted at motors

g.desc: Wired XIAO ESP32-S3 Sense and GY-521; motor suppression capacitors fitted at motors

g.text: PWM1 = D0 / GPIO1; PWM2 = D1 / GPIO2; PWM3 = D3 / GPIO4; PWM4 = D8 / GPIO7.

g.desc: PWM1 = D0 / GPIO1; PWM2 = D1 / GPIO2; PWM3 = D3 / GPIO4; PWM4 = D8 / GPIO7.

g.text: J15 → XIAO underside BAT+; J16 → GND. J17 → D10 / GPIO9. Never connect motors to 3V3 or USB 5V.

g.desc: J15 → XIAO underside BAT+; J16 → GND. J17 → D10 / GPIO9. Never connect motors to 3V3 or USB 5V.

g.text: GY-521: module VCC → XIAO 3V3, GND → GND, SDA → D4/GPIO5, SCL → D5/GPIO6; AD0 → GND.

g.desc: GY-521: module VCC → XIAO 3V3, GND → GND, SDA → D4/GPIO5, SCL → D5/GPIO6; AD0 → GND.

g.text: Verify actual module regulator/logic levels. Fit one 100 nF directly across each motor. No SD card.

g.desc: Verify actual module regulator/logic levels. Fit one 100 nF directly across each motor. No SD card.

g.text: 1S only: 3.2–4.20 V. All grounds common. No motor current through XIAO traces.

g.desc: 1S only: 3.2–4.20 V. All grounds common. No motor current through XIAO traces.

g.text: M1 front-right CW; M2 rear-right CCW; M3 rear-left CW; M4 front-left CCW (viewed from above).
